subject: general
question: Which one of the following sages of ancient India wrote 'Mimamsa-sutra'?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Jaimini.__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mimamsa-sutra was written by Jaimini** encompasses the Nyaya-vaisheshika systems and emphasises the concept of valid knowledge**. **
 
• **According to Purva Mimamsa, Vedas are eternal and possess all knowledge.​**
 
• According to Mimamsa's philosophy, Vedas are eternal and possess all knowledge, and religion means the fulfilment of duties prescribed by the Vedas.
 
• It says that the essence of the Vedas is dharma. By the execution of dharma, one earns merit which leads one to heaven after death.
